verdict.rationale: Stripe documents machine-learning risk scores on every authorization, covering fraud risk, merchant dispute risk and card-testing detection. These scores can feed real-time synchronous-webhook approve/decline decisions, and lost or stolen cards can be replaced. However, the risk-score claim comes from the Issuing-for-agents page, and there is no evidence of suspicious-activity alerting or an explicit block/freeze action for a compromised card. Merchant, category and country spending controls are adjacent controls, not card blocking. Missing for 10: suspicious-activity alerts or notifications, documented card block/freeze for compromised cards, confirmation that risk scores apply to all Issuing programs and not just agent cards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
